title: STREAM: An Objective-Driven and Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Industrial Energy Data Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2608.26754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial energy management requires datasets that connect energy use with equipment states, production batches, material flows, and process conditions. However, conventional acquisition workflows commonly emphasize connectivity and storage without verifying whether accessible signals satisfy the requirements of a defined energy-performance assessment. This paper presents STREAM, an objective-driven and uncertainty-aware framework comprising Specification of Objectives, Technical Requirements, Resource Mapping, Extraction from Sources, Archival Metadata, and Migration to Database. STREAM is the central workflow: objective-to-data traceability is its end-to-end output, while measurement, temporal, contextual, and processing uncertainty are assessed across all six stages. translated_title: STREAM：面向工业能源数据采集的目标驱动与不确定性感知框架
translated_abstract: 工业能源管理需要将能源使用与设备状态、生产批次、物料流和工艺条件联系起来的数据集。然而，传统的采集工作流程通常强调连接性和存储，而未验证可访问的信号是否满足既定能源绩效评估的要求。本文提出了STREAM，一个目标驱动且不确定性感知的框架，包括目标规范、技术要求、资源映射、源提取、归档元数据和数据库迁移。STREAM是核心工作流程：目标到数据的可追溯性是其端到端输出，而测量、时间、上下文和处理不确定性在六个阶段中均得到评估。与原始概念性的STREAM序列相比，本文增加了阶段级工件、最小证据门、源适用性规则、元数据模板和更新机制。
tldr: 本文提出STREAM框架，通过目标驱动和不确定性感知的六阶段流程，确保工业能源数据采集满足能源绩效评估需求，并增强数据可追溯性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STREAM, an objective-driven and uncertainty-aware six-stage framework that ensures industrial energy data acquisition meets energy-performance assessment needs and enhances data traceability.
